description_md:
# What You Get

- 
Skill Chaining Kit. Two complete skill chains for Claude Code, ready to drop into any project.

- 
Launch Chain (6 skills). Type /launch-offer and get a competitor analysis, sales page, 3-email sequence, LinkedIn + Twitter posts, and a professional PDF. All from one command.

- 
Brain Chain (4 skills). Type /brain-brief and get a comprehensive briefing on any topic in your Obsidian vault. Searches notes, extracts insights, synthesizes everything.

README with the 3-part pattern. Learn how to build your own chains in minutes. The secret is one line of markdown.
---
How It Works
Each skill writes to a shared folder. The next skill reads what came before and builds on it. An orchestrator skill with "context: fork" runs them all in sequence, autonomously.
No code. No automation platform. Just markdown files that Claude Code executes.
